annotations.title: What the tokens PumpPill logged actually did

description: Forward-measured outcomes across both chains: the share of logged tokens that doubled, reached 5x, 10x, or never moved. Entry is the market cap at the MOMENT OF LOGGING, never backfilled, and losers are in the denominator: a population measurement, not a track record. Recomputed hourly; a call during the recompute may take 45s or answer error='recomputing', and a retry a minute later is instant.
